tasha_solutions: Heads-up — Brightline pre-sales security call tomorrow 11am PT. They sent a 15-item questionnaire but are prioritizing three asks: (1) timeline and audit proof for RBAC changes, (2) how we redact/export tenant logs for on-prem/private, and (3) KMS envelope handling + HSM connector CVE posture. Can sec team assemble short answers + sample artifacts? cc @michael_seceng

michael_seceng: I can take (1) & (3). For RBAC timeline we should supply a concise change log + signed attestation and a short playbook for rollback/IR. For the HSM connector, which CVE did they reference?

tasha_solutions: They referenced a tracker ID in their doc: BH-2026-089 (notes "hsm-connector: deserialization issue") — asked whether we block upgrades, and what mitigation controls we have around firmware/KMS envelope handling.

elena_secops: For (2) we can produce an export sample showing redaction and the strip-and-mask pipeline. Quick example (this is the minimal snippet we'll include in the packet):

```bash
# export recent audit lines for tenant t-12345 (90d window)
redwoodctl logs export --tenant t-12345 --since 90d --format jsonl --filter "event_type:auth OR event_type:role_change" 
# pipe through redaction rule set (server-side)
redwoodctl redact --rules /etc/redwood/redact-rules.yaml > t-12345-logs.jsonl
```

Sample redaction rule (human summary): mask:secret, mask:bearer_token, remove:full_credit_card_number

Example sanitized line we plan to attach (single line JSONL):
`\{"ts\":\"2026-03-10T18:12:23Z\",\"actor\":\"user:***REDACTED***\",\"action\":\"role.assign\",\"details\":\"role:read_only\"}`

jamie_infra: On the HSM connector CVE: we tracked a vulnerable transitive in hsm-connector v1.2.3 -> crypto-bridge 0.9. The issue is deserialization of admin messages. We've pushed a patch to our internal fork (v1.2.4) and have a mitigation for private deployments: enforce admin messages over TLS mutual auth + validate message schema on ingress. For Dedicated/Hosted customers we have a policy to block the vulnerable version in our deployment manifest.

michael_seceng: Good. For the customer packet I recommend: 1) a one-page attestation of RBAC change history + signed hash (PGP) of the change log, 2) sample exported & redacted log lines plus the CLI commands, 3) KMS envelope diagram + statement of HSM connector mitigation and a short timeline of actions taken. I'll draft the attestation template.

elena_secops: For incident response / vuln triage we should include the exact timeline fields they asked for: detection_ts, triage_owner, mitigation_start_ts, rollout_complete_ts, postmortem_link. Example table row for BH-2026-089 (we'll fill precise timestamps):
- detection_ts: 2026-03-08T14:21:00Z
- triage_owner: jamie_infra
- mitigation_start_ts: 2026-03-08T18:00:00Z
- rollout_complete_ts: 2026-03-09T03:12:00Z
- postmortem_link: https://redwood.internal/pm/bh-2026-089

sre_oncall: I can attach a signed export of the audit search (sha256 hash) from our retention system and a screenshot from the console for their verification. Will need a request ticket from AE to include tenant ID and scope.

audit-bot: Automatic note: Retention policy link -> https://docs.redwood.com/security/log-retention (retention windows: hosted=365d, dedicated=365d, private=customer-configurable).

michael_seceng: Action items:
- michael_seceng: Draft RBAC attestation + PGP-signed change log (due EOD).
- elena_secops: Produce redaction/export example & redact rules (due EOD).
- jamie_infra: Confirm HSM connector patch version, mitigation steps, and include rollout timeline (due EOD).
- sre_oncall: Produce signed log export + console screenshot once AE sends tenant scope (due ASAP).

tasha_solutions: Perfect — I'll consolidate into a one-pager and ship to Brightline pre-call. If anything blocks your EOD ask, ping me here or DM. :thumbsup:

elena_secops: Will also add a short IR playbook excerpt showing steps to rotate envelopes and perform tenant key rewrap: rotation -> verify -> snapshot logs -> notify.

jamie_infra: Note: for private deployments we also recommend HSM firmware attestation before connector upgrades — will include recommended command and checklist.

michael_seceng: Thanks team. If anyone has a short anonymized sample of a redacted export we can attach now, drop it in the thread and I'll weave it into the attestation.

sre_oncall: putting a pinned note in meeting doc with checklist and files once AE replies with tenant ids.

tasha_solutions: OK closing loop — will confirm tenant scope with customer and post back here by 08:30 PT tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
